entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
Vessels carrying out potentially illegal activities have been the target of maritime surveillance patrols conducted in Fiji, Niue and Cook Islands’ Exclusive Economic Zones.
 
In operations supporting both the Pacific Islands Forum Fisheries Agency and the New Zealand Customs response to deter and disrupt transnational, serious and organised crime in the Pacific, a MC-12K King Air undertook patrols and photographed vessels of interest for follow-up by authorities. 

Full story ➡️ nzdf.mil.nz/Pacific-patrols
